card.name: SELinux object role and section numbers
card.fires_on: The word "object" in SELinux security contexts such as unconfined_u:object_r:httpd_sys_content_t. It also fires weakly on the digit after the decimal point in subsection numbers such as 4.1 or 7.1.

modes.label: SELinux context
modes.description: The word "object" in the user:role:type label of file listings and restorecon output.

modes.label: Subsection number
modes.description: The digit after the point in a numbered subsection heading, such as 4.1 or 7.1, in a label's cross-references.

card.plain: It marks the word "object" in Linux file-security labels and, more weakly, the digit in section numbers like 4.1.
